title: Norfolk stately home named the most haunted place to visit this Halloween
excerpt: Blickling Hall has topped a list of the 16 most haunted places to visit this Halloween, compiled by The Independent.
content:
Blickling Hall named the most haunted location in UK

Blickling Hall has been named the most haunted place in the UK to visit this Halloween. (Image: Antony Kelly)

This article is brought to you by our exclusive subscriber partnership with our sister title USA Today, and has been written by our American colleagues. It does not necessarily reflect the view of The Herald.

A north Norfolk stately home has been named the most haunted place in the UK.

Blickling Hall topped a list of the 16 most haunted places to visit this Halloween, compiled by The Independent.

The Jacobean building is known for its centuries-old gardens, 4,600 acres of woodland and one of the most extensive private library collections in the UK.

However, it is the chilling tales of the apparition of Anne Boleyn that have added to its reputation.

Anne Boleyn, who was born at Blickling Hall and later beheaded by her husband Henry VIII, is reportedly seen every year on May 19, the anniversary of her execution.

Her ghost, dressed in white and carrying her severed head, is said to arrive by coach, driven by four headless horsemen on four headless horses.

Blickling Hall outdid other reputedly haunted spots like the Tower of London to the top spot.

The home is celebrated for its gardens and library, but it is the tales of Anne Boleyn’s apparition that have crowned it the most haunted place in the UK.
